column1: # The models under test. One row per model; columns are tab-separated.
#   id                  HuggingFace repo id, character for character
#   gated               yes -> needs HF_TOKEN and accepted terms on the model page
#   max_model_len       vLLM context. Lowered for 8B models: at bf16 they are
#                       ~16 GiB of weights on a 22 GiB card, and KV cache takes
#                       what is left. 32768 does not fit alongside them.
#   role                why this model is in the sweep at all
# Cosmos3-Edge is the measured baseline. The other three exist to answer
# questions the first run could not: does a bigger model in the same family
# detect presence any better, and does NVIDIA's physical-AI post-training buy
# anything over the base model it started from?

column4: primary — the brief's recommendation, already measured
size-scaling point in the Reason family
reference — its model card documents the timestamp mechanism
CONTROL — the base model Reason2-8B was post-trained from
